title: Provisional Credit Eligibility Guidelines (Internal)
summary: This internal guide sets eligibility rules for provisional credit during credit card transaction disputes. Customers qualify only if: account is open ≥60 days, dispute reason is unauthorized_fraudulent_charge/duplicate_charge/goods_services_not_received (only if purchase >30 days), amount is $25.00–tier max ($2500 Bronze, $5000 Silver, $10000 Gold, $15000 Platinum, $25000 Diamond Elite), they have ≤2 disputes in past 12 months (checked via get_current_dispute_count), and for non-fraud reasons they contacted the merchant first.
